subject.statement: Jordan Belfort (former stockbroker known as the Wolf of Wall Street)
disambiguators: former stockbroker known as the Wolf of Wall Street

summary: As of 2026-10-01, Jordan Belfort (full legal name Jordan Ross Belfort, born 1962-07-09) remains adversely regarded due to a felony conviction for securities fraud and money laundering stemming from his 1999 guilty plea, for which he served 22 months in prison; this conviction has not been pardoned or vacated and continues to define his public profile as a former stockbroker and author.

findings.statement: Jordan Belfort's full legal name is Jordan Ross Belfort and his date of birth is 1962-07-09.
Jordan Belfort is a former stockbroker and author who founded Stratton Oakmont and published the memoir The Wolf of Wall Street.
Jordan Belfort pleaded guilty to securities fraud and money laundering in 1999, served 22 months of a four-year sentence, and this felony conviction remains on his record as of 2026-10-01.
